answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13027 Country: India Title: What is ruling regarding salataul awwabin (min 6 rakat max 20 rakat) prayed after magrib? Question: What is ruling regarding salataul awwabin (min 6 rakat max 20 rakat) prayed after magrib? Answer ID: 13027 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 818/818=M/1430) Awwabin is an important salah proved by reliable sources, it has many virtues mentioned in Hadith. Hadhrat Abu Hurairah ( رضی اللہ عنہ ) narrated that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) stated: ?One who performs 6 rak?ah after Maghrib without uttering any bad thing in between, it will be equal to the worship of 12 years.? While, another tradition says: ?One who performs 20 rak?ah after Maghrib, Allah will build a house for him in Paradise .? (Tirmizi 1:98) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
